name: marker
useFor: Mark where a day begins (separator, "Yesterday"), where unread messages start (unread), or an event in a thread (default with a MarkerIcon, "Ray joined the conversation"). Use border to head a short list.
constraints: A colored pill around a date
source: Extrapolated from the Inkbox console (Figma 427:2715): the inbox dates (muted) and the rail rules
title: Marker
description: A 12px muted marker in a conversation or list, alone, between two hairlines, ruled underneath, or as the purple unread line.
